description: Real-data-only zero-centered discriminator input-gradient penalty R1=(gamma/2) E[||grad_x D(x)||^2], computed per sample and averaged over the batch (Mescheder et al., Section 4.1, Eq. (9), paper.txt:813-819). Bind logits_or_prediction to the real sample tensor and targets to its discriminator scores from the same forward pass; structured-objective bindings are implemented in src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.title: Regularize a critic on real samples with R1

name: R1 gradient penalty

parameters.additional parameters: gamma is the only accepted key in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.gamma: finite nonnegative real scale (default 10.0, the CIFAR-10 setting reported in paper Section 5.3)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because discriminator scores have no ignored target classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point real sample tensor shaped [B,...] with B > 0 and requires_grad=True
parameters.reduction: none returns per-example penalties, mean averages the batch, or sum totals the batch (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point discriminator scores shaped [B] or [B,1], differentiably computed from the same real samples
